# scala-cardinality self-measurement — 2026-11-06

The plugin measuring this repository, analyzer at main e57a10f plus this pass. It replaces
self-2026-11-03.txt (removed; in git history), which measured 35 core sources; core now has 168. Command: `sbt publishLocal`,
then `sbt cardinalityReport` in a fresh sbt session (the plugin is loaded when the session starts).

Reduction pass (cardinality-reduction skill), with behavior gated by `core/testFull` (84 suites green):

- Stage 2 (closed vocabulary in a String): `StdlibModel.Reading.Excluded(why: String)` was only ever
  built from three string constants. It is now `Excluded(reason: Exclusion)`, and `Exclusion` is an
  enum of `Reflection | Revealing | Collected` that carries the same message text. `Reading` went
  from `2ε₀ + ω + 4` to `2ε₀ + 7`, and the `Excluded` constructor from ω to 3. The three `val`
  message rows are gone.
- Stage 3 (case analysis outside the sum): four sites pulled the declaration out of a `Found`
  result by matching `case Found.Entry(entry)`. `Found` now owns `declared: Option[TypeEntry]`,
  and `Found.declared(resolver, tpe, context)` replaces two identical private helpers
  (`InferredResults.declared`, `BinderBounds.declaration`).
- Stage 4 (hand-rolled machinery), with semantics checked against the cats-core 2.13.0 sources:
  - `Conversions.all`, a short-circuiting `Option` fold, became `flatTraverse`. List
    `traverseViaChain` with `Option.map2Eval` runs left to right and stops at the first `None`.
  - The `ConstrainedReceivers` max-fold became `foldLeftM`.
  - `NeutralSaturation.tuples`, a hand-written cartesian product, became `sequence`. The order is
    the same.
  - `Linearization.bases`, a worklist, became `Graphs.reachable`.
  - `Counter.standard` merged two identical branches, and `Scope`'s `if`/`Some`/`None` became
    `Option.when`.
- Kept, and not a target:
  - String fields that hold rendered refusal reasons over open names.
  - `Map[String, _]` fields, which are ε₀.
  - Function-valued solver fields.
  - The finite knob products (`SourceSnapshot.Limits`, `AnalysisQuery.Budget`,
    `MethodAnalysis.Limits`).
  - `TemplateClosures.Closure.Hidden(why)`: a rendered "X is local" / "X is private" message.
    Splitting it adds a case and a renderer and moves no tier.
- Analyzer finding: an unsupplied `import cats.syntax.all.*` makes 23 rows `?` (the wildcard may
  bind `Inhabitation`, `BodyTerms`, …). The cats syntax is therefore imported by name
  (`cats.syntax.traverse.toTraverseOps`, `cats.syntax.foldable.toFoldableOps`).
- Net row diff against the pre-pass run: no row moves up a tier. Signatures went from 3935 to 3932,
  and countably-infinite ones from 498 to 494.

Second pass, re-measured at main 73887ec (core now 171 sources) plus the change below, gated by
`core/testFull` (84 suites green), `plugin/scripted`, scalafmt/scalafix, file metrics and the CPD gate:

- Stage 2 (closed vocabulary in a String, catalog R1), in two exception messages:
  - `Natural.Exceeded(limit: String)` was built from three templates over the constants
    `MaxNodes`, `MaxHeight` and `MaxLiteralBits`. It is now `Exceeded(breach: Breach)`, with
    `Breach` an enum of `Nodes | Height | Literal` that renders the same text. The definition and
    its constructor go from ω to 3.
  - `Inhabitation.Limit(message: String)` was built from two fixed messages and one carrying
    `maxStates`. It is now `Limit(budget: Budget)`, with `Budget` an enum of
    `Depth | TraversalDepth | States(max: Int)`. The definition goes from ω to ≤2^33 and the
    constructor from ω to 2^32 + 2 (two fixed cases plus `States`' 2^32).
- Row diff against a pre-pass run at 73887ec: those two rows leave the ω tier; `Budget`,
  `Budget.States.<init>` and `Breach` are new finite rows; `Natural`'s extension block moves from
  line 54 to 63 (a renamed row, no count change). Nothing else moves. Signatures 3958 → 3959;
  finite 189 → 192, countably infinite 497 → 495.
